meta.title: Forum — OpenAEC Foundation
meta.description: Ask a question, share an idea or show what you make with the OpenAEC tools. The OpenAEC Foundation forum runs on GitHub Discussions.

header.label: Community
header.desc: Ask a question, share an idea or show what you make with the tools. Users, engineers and developers help each other here.

q.title: Questions
q.desc: How do I do this? Why does that not work? Ask the community.

i.title: Ideas
i.desc: A feature you miss or a tool that does not exist yet.

s.title: Show and tell
s.desc: Projects, scripts and drawings you made with the tools.

a.title: Announcements
a.desc: New releases, events and news from the foundation.

recent.title: Recent discussions
recent.noscript: Without JavaScript the discussions are not shown here. Pick a tool below to read them on GitHub.

boards.title: Per tool
boards.desc: Is your question about one tool? Then it fits best with that tool, where its developers read along.

how.title: How it works
how.li1: The forum runs on GitHub Discussions. Anyone can read along; to reply you need a free GitHub account.
how.li2: Write in Dutch or English. English reaches the most developers.
how.li3: Found a bug in a tool? Please report it as an issue for that tool, or via the Feedback button at the top right.
how.li4: Be friendly and help each other: everyone was a beginner once.
